newsitem.title: USA: First Republic takes stake in advisory firm.
newsitem.headline: First Republic takes stake in advisory firm.

text.p: First Republic Bancorp Inc said Monday it bought a 19.9 percent stake in New York investment advisor Trainer, Wortham & Co Inc for $7 million cash.
First Republic said it has an option to increase its ownership in the privately-held firm, which manages $2 billion in assets for wealthy individuals and institutional investors.
The company said it bought the stake through its wholly-owned subsidiary First Republic Savings Bank.
First Republic said on May 28 it had instructed its investment bankers to stop searching for a buyer for the company, but added it was still considering strategic alliances, including an acquistion.
Shares rose 1/2 to 22 in early morning activity.
